one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer that writes, runs, and tests code.
blocker: API credentials require a Devin account on an Individual or Teams plan; no free tier or trial is documented in the supplied material.

evidence.claim: Devin offers a documented public API for integrations and automation
evidence.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.

evidence.claim: REST API split into organization and enterprise scopes covering sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, and more
evidence.quote: **Base URL:**`https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/*`For managing resources within a single organization — sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, and more.

evidence.claim: Authentication uses API keys (service user keys or personal access tokens) sent as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header
evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request:

evidence.claim: Access is self-serve signup but tied to paid Individual or Teams plans; no free tier documented
evidence.quote: To access Devin, sign up at [app.devin.ai](https://app.devin.ai/). Individual and Teams plans are available.

evidence.claim: Vendor's own docs document a Devin MCP server requiring cog_-prefixed service user keys
evidence.quote: with the [Devin MCP](https://docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp) — only `cog_`-prefixed keys are supported

notes: Vendor-documented Devin MCP exists at docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp and only supports cog_-prefixed service user keys (legacy apk_ keys rejected). v1 and v2 legacy APIs are deprecated but functional; v3 adds RBAC, session attribution via create_as_user_id, and cursor pagination. Enterprise API scope (/v3/enterprise/*) is restricted to enterprise customers. PATs are governed by an enterprise policy disabled by default. Material does not state pricing or whether any free trial exists, so paid_plan_required is inferred from the paid Individual/Teams plan structure.
